item.title: American startup raises $180 million to drill rock over 5km deep to build world's first superhot geothermal plant at 500 °C
item.description: Quaise Energy has successfully raised $180 million for its groundbreaking superhot geothermal plant initiative. Utilizing cutting-edge microwave technology, the project vaporizes rock instead of using conventional drill bits. Collaboration with Nabors Industries will provide essential drilling expertise and equipment. The Obsidian Project, located in Oregon, is set to generate 50 MW by 2030, paving the way for a sustainable energy future.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: A Colombian man struggling to build his own home created Lego-like bricks from recycled plastic
item.description: A Colombian architect helped develop Lego-like building blocks made from recycled plastic and rubber to create temporary and permanent homes. The system was used to build shelters for 42 displaced families in Guapi in 2015. Four people could assemble a 40-square-metre house in five days, without using glue, cement or water.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: USS Abraham Lincoln sails past Singapore on way home after gruelling Middle East deployment
item.description: The USS Abraham Lincoln, an aircraft carrier, is heading back home after more than 250 days of supporting operations in the Middle East, recently passing by Singapore. Despite reports of declining crew morale and supply difficulties, US Navy representatives have rejected the idea of a widespread mental health crisis. The ship is expected to stop in Thailand before concluding its journey back to the US.
item.dc:creator: Trisha Mahajan

item.title: ‘Identify your real enemy’: Khamenei urges Gulf rulers to unite, defend each other
item.description: Iran's Supreme Leader urged Gulf rulers to identify their real enemy and confront it. He also called for Muslim unity and mutual defense against external threats. The message comes amid ongoing war and significant economic pressure on Iran. Iranian President dismissed speculation about the leader's health, stating he is healthy. Diplomacy and defense remain Iran's complementary approach to national interests.
item.dc:creator: Yashasvi Vasistha

item.title: A 55-year-old Missouri official reached the 13,804-foot summit of Wyoming's highest mountain
item.description: In a remarkable tale of survival, a Missouri deputy attorney general was found alive after an arduous five-day ordeal on Gannett Peak. Despite achieving his goal of reaching the summit, he faced severe dehydration and confusion near Scott Lake. Fortunately, search teams successfully located him amidst the challenging terrain, and he is now in recovery, expressing heartfelt gratitude to his rescuers for their relentless efforts.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: A Milwaukee landlord found a peculiar print hanging in a vacant apartment; it turned out to be an original Picasso
item.description: The mysterious disappearance of a Picasso etching since 2018 has come to a surprising conclusion with its rediscovery in a landlord's apartment. With an estimated worth of $35,000 to $50,000, the piece drew attention when the landlord recognized the signature. After an antique dealer confirmed its validity, the police praised the landlord’s integrity in returning the artwork. The gallery owner celebrated the emotional triumph of reclaiming the cherished etching.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Indian-origin teen accused of killing family allegedly used ChatGPT for ‘fantasy stories’
item.description: A tutor's alarming visit in Acton, Massachusetts, unveiled a grim double homicide involving a mother and her young son. The police later apprehended the grieving elder sibling in his mother's car nearby. Disturbingly, prosecutors disclosed that the teenager employed AI and ChatGPT to delve into hypothetical murder scenarios, prompting a critical examination of artificial intelligence's influence on harmful behaviors.

item.title: Kick streamer Neon reacts to viral GTA 6 character resembling him after Rockstar’s Netflix showcase
item.description: The recent gameplay reveal for GTA 6 has sparked considerable buzz online, especially among gaming enthusiasts. A side mission featured a character reminiscent of Kick streamer Neon, who shared his thrill at possibly inspiring the game's development. During a subsequent livestream, he even recreated the now-famous scene, showcasing how GTA 6 is weaving in contemporary internet phenomena into its narrative.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Is the viral video really Kai Cenat being assaulted by police? Here’s the truth
item.description: A misidentified viral video showing a police altercation has led many to erroneously believe that streamer Kai Cenat is involved. The clip, which actually depicts a traffic stop in Arkansas, features a man who resisted an officer's commands. This individual's likeness to Cenat has fueled the false narrative, which quickly gained traction on social media.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Kim Jong UN shakes up North Korea’s military, dismisses defence minister No Kwang Chol
item.description: North Korea has shaken up its military hierarchy by removing the defense minister, a move approved by Kim Jong Un in a recent leadership meeting. This change mirrors advancements at the nation's weapons research center, which has introduced new combat weapon systems. As tensions rise, trilateral military drills involving South Korea, the US, and Japan will carry on, designed to counter North Korea's ongoing nuclear and missile provocations.
item.dc:creator: Trisha Mahajan
